dgVoodoo2 is copyright (c) 2013-2026 Dege.

The official general readme states that individual dgVoodoo files may be
freely shipped with a game or game mod. This project ships only the three
individual x86 wrapper files needed by the Medieval: Total War compatibility
fix; it does not redistribute dgVoodoo2 as a standalone component, launcher,
or general-purpose framework.

Official documentation:
https://dege.fw.hu/dgVoodoo2/ReadmeGeneral/

Official release:
https://github.com/dege-diosg/dgVoodoo2/releases/tag/v2.87.2
